dimensions.name: Relationship recovery under a prescribed specification
Relationship discovery from data alone
dimensions.justification: Feature importances only, no false-discovery control. Common permutation rule on planted tasks: TPR 1.0 (interactions 10/10), FDR 0.412, silent on 1/5 null tasks.

dimensions.name: Experimental iteration speed
dimensions.justification: Session median 6.7 s, p90 8.3 s per follow-up (seconds per fit). Real battery median 3.0 s.

dimensions.name: Robustness across conditions
dimensions.justification: Completes 285/285 real runs with native missing-value and categorical handling; small-n median 8.0% below the reference. Large-n unmeasured.

dimensions.name: Uncertainty honesty (calibration)
dimensions.justification: MultiQuantile 5%/95% intervals: median coverage 0.752, 90.9% of runs below 0.85; S3 terciles 0.661/0.726/0.716. Binary median ECE 0.027.

dimensions.name: Reproducibility and auditability
dimensions.justification: Predictions identical on rerun for 10/10 datasets with a fixed seed; no decision trail.

dimensions.name: Predictive validity
dimensions.justification: Competitive across both task families under matched (default) settings: within 5% of the best complete arm on 34/45 regression and 29/50 binary tasks; median gap 0.0% and 3.9%. Not confirmed on held-back task families (anchor 5).
